purpose: Source-backed, non-redundant roadmap for six advanced facets; records observed evidence, proposed gates and explicit blockers without promoting knowledge.

snapshot.source_scope: Selected checkout plus explicitly identified G19 reference records; no external claims are added.
snapshot.content_boundary: Structural presence, a manifest, a README, a serializer or a proposed test does not prove factual, technical, legal, licensing, runtime, financial, educational or professional correctness.

decision_contract.non_redundancy_rule: Each facet routes to existing canonical owner candidates. Aliases and lifecycle facets are filters or cross-links, not additional skills.
decision_contract.promotion_rule: No facet moves beyond roadmap-only until provenance, version/effective context, rights, deterministic runtime evidence where relevant, evaluation and qualified human review agree.
decision_contract.external_action_boundary: No automatic filing, sending, payment, publication, certification, signing, professional approval or execution is authorized.

facets.label: CAD API
facets.non_redundancy_rationale: An API wrapper or geometry operation is an execution facet of CAD/BIM interoperability. It must not become a second CAD skill or a professional design/conformity claim.

local_evidence.observed: CAD_Library/training_corpus/README.md describes DXF/STEP/3DS raw and parsed data, a source/licence manifest and parser tooling.
local_evidence.not_observed: A target CAD API adapter, live desktop integration or acceptance result.

local_evidence.observed: G19 records cad-autocad-freecad in codex/uni-corpus, release blocked, and absent from the inventory checkout.

prerequisites: Target API/application and version pinned.
Read/create/transform/export operation contract and geometry invariants defined.
Deterministic fixture, environment and fail-closed error contract recorded.
Fixture source, derivative rights and attribution recorded; research-only material excluded from commercial/training route until cleared.
expected_evidence: API/version manifest and command log.
Input/output checksums and structured operation result.
Entity/type counts, units, coordinate frame, bounding-box and identity invariants.
Negative-case reproduction and rights record.
Qualified CAD review when output is intended as a professional deliverable.
runtime_tests: Read-only parse of permissive DXF and STEP fixtures; repeat and compare structured output.
Export/import round trip with declared invariants.
Malformed input and unsupported-version rejection.
Missing dependency, timeout and licence-policy failure retained as evidence.
facets.licensing_gate: Use the local manifest's permissive/research classes as a policy input, retain upstream notices and separately clear the target SDK, plug-ins, fonts, blocks and derivatives.
facets.professional_review: CAD technician, architect or engineer reviews units, coordinates, layers, dimensions, topology and the intended deliverable; file integrity is kept separate from geometric accuracy and conformity.
blocked_states: Target API or version unknown.
Runtime unavailable or round trip changes an invariant.
Fixture or derivative rights unresolved.
Output is presented as a professional drawing without qualified review.
claims_not_made: No CAD API implementation is claimed.
No live AutoCAD/FreeCAD result is claimed.
No geometry, regulatory conformity or authorisation is certified.

facets.label: IFC QA
facets.non_redundancy_rationale: IFC QA records model checks against a canonical BIM/interoperability owner; it does not duplicate IFC teaching content or certify design adequacy.

local_evidence.observed: Raw IFC samples and a local MIT notice are present; the manifest/serializer describe six-building index fields including schema, file name and sampled entity types.
local_evidence.not_observed: Generated parsed/ifc_bim_index.jsonl or a complete QA report.

local_evidence.observed: G19 records bim-ifc-openbim in codex/uni-corpus with release blocked and inventory-head presence false.
local_evidence.not_observed: The referenced SKILL.md in this checkout.

prerequisites: IFC parser and schema/profile pinned.
Every model inventoried with checksum, source and licence.
Checks separated into lexical, schema, geometric and semantic classes.
Severity and professional escalation rules defined.
expected_evidence: Per-file manifest, header/schema and tool version.
Entity/relationship/property findings and coordinate/unit report.
Deterministic report hash and malformed-model reproduction.
MIT attribution and rights record.
BIM coordinator decision and limitations.
runtime_tests: Parse each local IFC fixture and compare summaries across two runs.
Flag missing header/schema fields rather than silently accepting them.
Detect duplicate GlobalIds, missing required properties, invalid references and unit/coordinate anomalies.
Retain a failing report for truncated or malformed input.
facets.licensing_gate: Retain the local MIT notice and upstream attribution; separately clear parser, schema profile, property set, derivative and downstream publication terms.
facets.professional_review: BIM coordinator or qualified design professional reviews profile, thresholds, coordinates and any decision affecting a deliverable or contract.
blocked_states: Parser/schema version or model provenance unknown.
Generated index absent or raw model invalid/truncated.
Coordinates/units not interpretable.
Semantic findings unreviewed or QA is used as design approval.
claims_not_made: No complete IFC QA implementation is claimed.
No clash-free, constructible or professionally conforming model is certified.

facets.label: Blender automation
facets.non_redundancy_rationale: Blender automation is a reproducible asset/render workflow, not a second architecture/CAD/media curriculum and not a way to promote interpreted geometry to verified reality.

local_evidence.observed: G19 records blender-3d-render in codex/uni-corpus with release blocked and inventory-head presence false.
local_evidence.not_observed: A Blender executable, .blend fixture or bpy automation in the selected checkout.

prerequisites: Blender version and execution mode pinned.
Approved or clearly synthetic fixture with source geometry separated from interpretation.
Scene contract for units, collections, camera, materials and outputs.
External asset, texture, font, HDRI and plug-in register.
expected_evidence: Blender version, command log and scene/script checksums.
Object/material/camera/collection manifest.
Deterministic rerun result and render metadata/hash.
Asset attribution/rights and visual/geometric review record.
runtime_tests: Headless scene open and expected object/collection assertions.
Two runs compared using a normalized scene manifest.
Controlled-fixture render compared with declared tolerance.
Failure on missing assets, invalid paths, hidden dependencies or unseeded randomness.
facets.licensing_gate: Blender software terms and every scene asset/derivative require separate review; no local Blender asset licence is established.
facets.professional_review: Architect/technician or visualization reviewer checks basis, scale, interpretation, camera and intended use; real-property 3D/render work waits for approved 2D/source basis.
blocked_states: Runtime or approved source geometry unavailable.
Asset rights missing or incompatible.
Script incomplete or non-deterministic.
Concept render labelled as surveyed, authorised, compliant or construction-ready.
claims_not_made: No Blender runtime or automation implementation is claimed.
No render is claimed to be an as-built survey or compliant model.

facets.label: PDF lifecycle
facets.non_redundancy_rationale: Lifecycle state, hashes, extraction and review govern a document artifact; the PDF container does not duplicate the technical subject or make it authoritative.

local_evidence.observed: The local extractor uses pypdf, page markers and restart checkpoints.
local_evidence.not_observed: An end-to-end lifecycle test or approved publication workflow.

local_evidence.observed: G19 records documents-pdf-computo-sal-due-diligence in codex/uni-corpus with release blocked and inventory-head presence false.
local_evidence.not_observed: The referenced SKILL.md in this checkout.

local_evidence.observed: G18 requires artifact state, version, decision, reviewer and audit trail and says a document-shaped file is not an authorized professional document.
local_evidence.not_observed: Any approval for a specific local PDF.

prerequisites: Lifecycle states and transition permissions defined.
Source hash, page count, metadata, tool/version, output hash and reviewer fields defined.
Native text versus OCR, redaction, retention and publication policy defined.
expected_evidence: Source PDF/checksum and page-count record.
Extracted text with page anchors, log and restart/recovery record.
Visual spot-check, rights decision, state transitions and reviewer log.
Final disposition, including blocked outcome when required.
runtime_tests: Known-PDF extraction with page markers and repeat comparison.
Interrupt at checkpoint and resume; rerun completed source.
Corrupt/encrypted/unreadable input failure with explicit result.
Human spot-check for page/text loss and path/encoding/redaction controls.
facets.licensing_gate: Treat manifest licence fields as inputs to review; separately handle official acts, public-domain, CC BY-SA, commercial sources and derived OCR/text with attribution and publication/training decisions.
facets.professional_review: Document controller plus the relevant engineer, architect, accountant or lawyer reviews completeness, version, scope, signatures and intended use.
blocked_states: Hash/version, extraction completeness or rights missing.
OCR/page loss, privacy/redaction or reviewer decision open.
Wrong lifecycle state or template mistaken for signed/filed document.
claims_not_made: No completed PDF lifecycle is claimed.
No extraction result is claimed to be complete, current, reusable or professionally approved.

facets.label: SAL reconciliation
facets.non_redundancy_rationale: SAL reconciliation compares supplied progress, quantity, contract and payment records; it is not a new accounting/price-list skill and cannot replace responsible professional approval.

local_evidence.observed: The README describes SAL/glossary coverage and a described document corpus containing a SAL template with retentions.
local_evidence.not_observed: The referenced parsed/documenti_tecnici.jsonl, a reconciler, an approved measurement ledger, price-list provenance or financial integration.

local_evidence.observed: G18 requires evidence lifecycle and qualified review for financial/professional claims.
local_evidence.not_observed: A reviewer decision for a real SAL.

prerequisites: Versioned input contract for items, measurements, units, quantities, prices, periods, prior/current/cumulative SAL, retentions, taxes and currency.
Source/computed separation, exact decimal arithmetic, variation-order and approval fields.
Tolerance and rounding rules approved by the responsible professional.
expected_evidence: Immutable input packet and hashes.
Source-to-line-item mapping and calculation trace.
Prior/current/cumulative totals, retention/tax/currency treatment.
Discrepancy, duplicate/missing-source and independent-recomputation report.
Signed or explicitly pending human decision.
runtime_tests: Synthetic exact-decimal reconciliation and deterministic rerun.
Rounding at line and total levels.
Duplicate lines, missing measurements, changed prices, cumulative regressions, currency mismatch and unsupported variation cases.
Inconsistent SAL must produce blocked and no automatic invoice/payment/reminder/filing.
facets.licensing_gate: Clear rights for every price list, contract, invoice, template and imported document; educational/public-domain labels do not clear commercial prezzari or customer records.
facets.professional_review: Direttore dei lavori/contabilità lavori and, where contractual or financial consequences exist, accountant or contract administrator review the source, variations, retentions, taxes and disposition.
blocked_states: Approved measurement or contract baseline missing.
Price-list/source rights, arithmetic, currency or variation approval unresolved.
Cumulative totals do not reconcile or reviewer absent.
Request implies automatic send, pay, certify or file.
claims_not_made: No SAL reconciler or financial integration is claimed.
No quantity, price, retention, tax or payment correctness is certified.

facets.label: Current-law lookup
facets.non_redundancy_rationale: Lookup selects and scopes sources for existing PA/legal skills; it does not copy statutes into a second corpus, turn historical text into current law or provide legal advice.

local_evidence.observed: The local NORME register records titles, source labels, URLs and date/currentness wording and assigns different licence labels during serialization.
local_evidence.not_observed: Generated parsed/norme_italiane.jsonl or current validity for a particular question on 2026-10-18.

local_evidence.observed: G17 states that current-law/professional-compliance answers require jurisdiction, effective date, source and qualified review.
local_evidence.not_observed: A legal reviewer decision or authoritative answer.

local_evidence.observed: G18 defines jurisdiction/time context and professional-review stop conditions.

prerequisites: Jurisdiction and question date required.
Authoritative source preference and source hierarchy recorded.
Publication/effective/repeal/amendment dates, retrieval time and checksum recorded.
Original source separated from interpretation; stale/conflict behavior defined.
Qualified reviewer route for legal, procurement, safety, tax or permit claims.
expected_evidence: Query scope and source/version/effective-date record.
Retrieval timestamp, checksum and permitted citation anchor.
Interpretation/source separation, conflict or staleness flag and limitation.
Reviewer role, decision and reproducible escalation/no-answer result.
runtime_tests: Specified jurisdiction/date must be carried into the result.
Older source must produce a staleness flag.
Conflicting versions must escalate.
Missing date/source must produce blocked.
Citation retention and no-filing/no-sending/no-certification boundary tested.
facets.licensing_gate: Verify rights and attribution for each edition, transcription, translation and derivative; a URL or public-act label is not blanket publication/training clearance.
facets.professional_review: Qualified legal reviewer for legal interpretation and qualified technical/procurement/safety reviewer for domain claims; record scope and decision.
blocked_states: Jurisdiction or effective date missing.
Source secondary/stale or amendment/repeal status unresolved.
Conflicting sources, rights or reviewer unresolved.
Output would be used as legal, permit, procurement, safety, tax or professional advice.
claims_not_made: No legal interpretation, advice or professional compliance is claimed.

global_blockers: G19 reference-library SKILL.md paths are recorded as absent from the inventory checkout.
Generated parsed artifacts described by local README/serializer evidence are absent for IFC, normative and technical-document indexes where noted.
No facet has a completed provenance packet, rights decision, deterministic runtime report and qualified professional sign-off in this decision log.
Static presence, parsing or unit-test success cannot be promoted to production safety, design adequacy, legal validity, financial correctness or professional conformity.

release_gates.label: Canonical mapping and non-redundancy
release_gates.pass_when: One canonical owner and alias resolution are reviewed; no facet creates a duplicate domain skill.
release_gates.does_not_prove: Semantic equivalence, source correctness or content completeness.

release_gates.label: Provenance, context and rights
release_gates.pass_when: Source/interpretation/example/hypothesis, version/effective context, jurisdiction/period, attribution and rights are recorded; otherwise status remains blocked.
release_gates.does_not_prove: That the source is factually correct or currently authoritative.

release_gates.label: Runtime and failure evidence
release_gates.pass_when: The target workflow runs with deterministic fixtures, environment metadata, reproducible outputs and retained negative cases.
release_gates.does_not_prove: Production safety, structural adequacy, legal validity or professional conformity.

release_gates.label: Professional review and release
release_gates.pass_when: The appropriate qualified reviewer records scope, limitations and decision; all open blockers are visible and no automatic external action is implied.

non_goals: Do not modify corpus, source packs, exams or fixtures as part of this roadmap artifact.
Do not merge or delete similar content based on text similarity alone.
Do not expose protected exam answers.
Do not publish, file, send, pay, sign, certify or execute an external action.
